facts.text: India, in the news: CJI **Surya Kant**; Solicitor-General **Tushar Mehta**; CEC **Gyanesh Kumar**; RGI **Mritunjay Kumar Narayan**; NSA **Ajit Doval**; FM **Nirmala Sitharaman**; Delhi Police Commissioner **Anurag Kumar**.

facts.text: Air Chief Marshal **Ashutosh Dixit** took over as the **29th Chief of the Air Staff** on 1 November 2026, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, who retired after 43 years of service.
